0.0: I feel like the creatures of the Krakian Jungle have changed. I'd like you to investigate, to make sure there's no threat to NLC.
0.1: Investigating is simple. Just hunt a bunch of them.

1.0: That's odd... it seems the monsters have become weaker. Well, that's good news for us.
1.1: But we can't get careless now. Check again tomorrow to make sure they don't change again.

mob.0: Hunt the monsters of the Krakian Jungle to learn more about them.
